source: Chess.com public games of the random sample, July–September 2026; export_pace_levels.py. Ten-minute games without increment, at least 20 plies. For each game: (600 minus final clock) divided by own moves; per player the median across games, and the median rating in those games. Players with at least 20 such games. Ratings rounded to 10, seconds to 0.1.

level.rule: players whose rating is within halfWidth of the reader's rapid rating; widened in steps of 50 until at least minPlayers
